title: Bearframe sprite motion target is eight directions
summary: Founder correction expands the animation target from four cardinal directions to N NE E SE S SW W NW. Each diagonal needs its own perspective-aware poses and registered feet; rotating whole sprites or replaying one standing view is not an accepted walk. Preserve canonical identity and asymmetric armor. Establish eight-direction static geometry before expanding gait cycles; static coverage must never be reported as eight complete animated directions.
source: Founder art feedback in Round24 continuation 2026-11-12; private assets excluded
